limitations: Backtest numbers are not a claim of a live edge; only settled ledger rows can make that claim.
Ratings use final margins only: no injuries, quarterbacks, rest, travel or weather.
Home advantage is a single learned constant per fit; it does not vary by team or drift inside a season.
The NCAAB source carries no betting lines, so market comparisons, selections and ledger rows are unavailable.

NCAAB: ESPN schedule files carry no betting lines, so market fields are null. Non-Division-I opponents (no ESPN conference) and teams with fewer than six games in a season are pooled into one NON_D1 rating; regular season and postseason (conference and national tournaments) are included; the optimizer budget per fold is reduced because of the ~365-team state.
